name: CoMO Cubing Winter 2024
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
